title: Short Term Internship 2027
field: Physics, engineering, computing and related fields
about: CERN, in Geneva, Switzerland, lists its Short Term Internship 2027 on the CERN careers portal, with field-specific postings including data science, AI and analytics, and information technologies. The postings close on 1 November 2027 at 23:59 Geneva time.
requirements: See the official careers.cern posting for eligibility

upskill.name: the Data Analytics Academy page
why: Record: postings include "data science, AI and analytics" → Data Analytics Academy: "Strengthen the statistical, mathematical and analytical foundations needed to interpret data, build reliable analyses". No single course matches the general posting (shortlist only matched the stem "comput"), so the post links to the Academy page, not a specific course.
